correctness.rationale: All 130 proper \(\mathrm{NC}_6\) partitions and 4621 original nonempty chains were enumerated from first principles. Rank-preserving rotation has no simplex inversions; all 779 quotient cells were computed with signed integral boundaries and two vanishing compositions. Reproducible exact unit-pivot reductions 25/152/207 yield a single coefficient 3 from C3 to C2 and eight free C3 generators, proving \(H_2=\mathbb Z/3\mathbb Z\) and \(H_3=\mathbb Z^8\). EL-shellability gives simply connected cover and rotation^2, rotation^3 have fixed points, generating \(C_6\); Armstrong proves simply connected quotient. Three-dimensional simply connected CW classification and Smith form prove the asserted homotopy type. No extrapolation.

evidence: Athanasiadis--Brady--Watt proves EL-shellability for the original NC lattice, hence its three-dimensional sphere wedge, but not the quotient by C6.
Donau studies ordinary partition lattices; his prime cyclic hypotheses do not apply to the composite sixfold action on the noncrossing subposet.
Reading counts chains in noncrossing lattices, but counting alone leaves boundary and integral torsion undetermined.
broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither shellability of the cover, enumeration of chains, nor results about a different lattice imply the complete integral homotopy type of this nonfree quotient.

originality.rationale: The strongest relevant accessible primary results address (i) EL-shellability of the unquotiented NC lattice, (ii) rotation classes of individual partitions, and (iii) orbit complexes of different lattices. None of their inspected hypotheses and conclusions implies the \(3\)-torsion Smith invariant of the six-point proper NC rotation orbit space. Targeted searches and comparison of nearby known homotopy/quotient results did not find an equivalent theorem. Absence of a match is not proof of absolute novelty; see residual risks.
residual_risks: An unindexed computation or unpublished source could already contain this exact six-point orbit-space homotopy type.
The Donau and Reading original full texts were not materially inspected; the available object and theorem summaries are distinct but coverage has not been conclusively excluded.
No independent mathematician has checked the finite verifier or topological deductions.

value.rationale: The finite \(\mathrm{NC}_6\) quotient is a canonical first composite cyclic noncrossing-partition test case with distinct nontrivial stabilizers. A complete homotopy classification explains the emergence of 3-torsion in a simply connected orbit space of a torsion-free sphere wedge; the attaching degree and Moore summand are not determined by partition-rotation counts or rational invariants. This is a motivated integral equivariant-topology example, without a claim of general n or downstream general theorem.
